name: v1-hand

name: v2-hand
description: v2 with the hand-written v2 plan: the redesigned flow works end to end.

name: v2-broken-hand
description: v2-broken with the v2 plan: the page confirms the order, the store has nothing.

name: v2-wrong-total-hand
description: v2-wrong-total with the v2 plan: the order is saved at the wrong price.

name: drift-needs-replan
description: v2 with the v1 plan and no locator cache: rung 3 heals the renamed buttons, shipping goes before payment (adaptive order), and rung 5 re-plans payment around the new Phone field and the extra screen. The healer does not believe it is done (the v1 plan looks for "Order confirmed"); the store decides.

name: unresolvable-hand
description: v2, an intent for a product that does not exist: the product card is a required scope, so rungs 2 and 3 guess nothing; rung 5 finds no way to it and the run stops RED within budget.

name: env-down
description: v1 with the server killed mid-run (after checkout starts): GREY, error named.

name: v1-baseline
description: v1 from an empty cache: plan produced; 0 heals; at most 4 LLM calls.

name: v1-cached
description: v1 after v1-baseline: 0 LLM calls.

reportIncludes: > Passed: the system of record has the new record

name: heal-warm-v1
description: P3 chain, step 1: v1 with the hand-written v1 plan warms the locator cache (rung 1, first successes cached).

name: heal-v2
description: P3 chain, step 2: v2 from the v1-warm locator cache, with the v1 labels in a plan already reflowed for v2 (what rung 5 will do in P4). Add to cart heals on rung 2 (it moved landmark); the bag, checkout and pay buttons heal on rung 3.

name: heal-v2-cached
description: P3 chain, step 3: v2 again from the healed cache: GREEN, every step on rung 1, 0 LLM calls.

name: heal-v2-broken
description: P3 chain, step 4: v2-broken from the v2 cache: no healing noise, RED on the state delta.

name: v2-drift

name: v2-cached
description: v2 after v2-drift: every step on rung 1, 0 LLM calls; the report names the healing run.

reportIncludes: > Passed: the system of record has the new record

name: v2-broken
description: v2-broken after v2-drift: 0 heals; state-delta failure; healerBelievedDone true.

name: v2-wrong-total
description: v2-wrong-total after v2-drift: the total mismatch is named with both values.

name: unresolvable
description: v2 after v2-drift, an intent for a product that does not exist (planned from scratch): RED unresolvable within budget, no hang.

name: provider-switch
description: v1 from an empty cache in live mode, once per provider with a key in .env; skipped, not failed, for providers without one.

name: replay-complete
description: All four acts of the demo, from runs/snapshots/post-act-1 and the committed llm-cache, with no API key present: every act as scripted, no cache misses, under 4 minutes.
